dct_description_sm: # Indonesia Volcano Eruption: Damage Proxy Maps, Apr 2024 The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these damage proxy maps for Indonesia Volcano Eruption (Apr 2024) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it. ## Maps in this dataset - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Indonesia, Volcano Eruption, 26 Apr 2024 wbd** (superseded) - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Indonesia, Volcano Eruption, 26 Apr 2024 wbd** (superseded) - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Indonesia, Volcano Eruption, 26 Apr 2024** - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Indonesia, Volcano Eruption, 26 Apr 2024** **More map details and files:** **More map details and files:** **Legal Disclaimer:** **Credits:** Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS), Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2023-2024)
